properties.note: This change admitted Interface to the VERIFIES target enumeration, which is the exact absence the finding measured. Verified 2026-09-07 against the running schema: VERIFIES now reaches Artifact, Capability, Component, Constraint, DesignRule, Interface and Requirement. The finding's central claim - that a contract is the one thing reflow2 cannot attach evidence to - stopped being true on that date and had gone 16 days without anything saying so, which is the fixed-but-never-closed class the overtaken-defect detector exists to catch. WHAT REMAINS TRUE IN IT and is worth keeping: the reasoning about why a contract is the node MOSA turns on, and the third-instance pattern about VERIFIES under-enumerating its own targets twice before. The record is stale in its verdict, not in its argument.
